title: Home
section: Have Information to Share on this page?
text:
Have Information to Share on this page?
We encourage everyone to share links to their best practices and tools they’ve developed. To share information, please go to the https://github.com/UG2-gliders/UG2-Community-Lab-Manual and click on the green’New Issue’ button (link herehttps://github.com/UG2-gliders/UG2-Community-Lab-Manual/issues).
Alternatively, join us on the UG2 Slack #open-science channel and ask to share!
